r0.t: Sticks it out a long way in delirium

r2.t: Crawling, ascending from throat to the tongue and lips, stiffening the tongue, with an attack of great anxiety

r3.t: Dryness of tip of tongue and lips without thirst, with anxious sweat

r4.t: Apparently livelier, but the tongue drier and increased thirst

r5.t: Tongue dry and very red, vivid delirium

r6.t: Tongue dry and very red, vivid delirium, with raving

r7.t: Sensation of dryness of the moist tongue, with anxiousness

r8.t: Sensation of dryness of the moist tongue, with anxiousness, with fevers

r10.t: Typhoid fever, and white, red borders with uneasiness to despair
